exposure: longitudinal surveillance through the Norwegian Quality and Surveillance Registry for Cerebral Palsy (NorCP)
outcome: streamlined process in diagnosis and follow-up
cohort: Individuals with cerebral palsy (CP) in Norway registered in the NorCP.
finding: The NorCP has increased the competence of health professionals, streamlined the diagnosis and follow-up process for children and youths with CP in Norway, and facilitated the use of evidence-based interventions.
who: Individuals with cerebral palsy (CP) in Norway
